cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got the instructions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.text: I've brought a blanket. Your heater's still broken?

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've put your usual mug out. We can still have tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'm hoping you won't leave me cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send a sad face.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Would you support a small improvement to the front garden?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What sort of improvement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Something with a pond. And no tree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Where's the tree?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's finish agreeing before the stump grinder leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. These eighty wedding place cards need names. Your bin labels have better lettering than our invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'd read the names. You'd only do the beautiful part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your aunt will complain if I use purple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle my aunt. The ink colour could be entirely yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. You could put it at eye level so I see what I'm missing.
